items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Reject unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, payback, production, requeue, experiment, telemetry, dependency, deployment, spending, and monetization claims. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed; keep financial outcomes unknown. Continue only existing repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, measurement, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Keep private launch gates, parked dispositions, and unsent outreach unchanged. Owner concern: any permission request requires human-counsel review before authorization.

Retain SEO, UX, affiliate, product, and repository opportunities as deferred backlog only. Do not create proposals, change requests, research requests, experiments, dependencies, deployments, or requeues this cycle. Reassess after ownership, root cause, validation, rollback, deduplication, attribution, and measurement readiness are documented.

Maintain financial containment. The available commission record is aggregate and not site-attributable; do not infer revenue, ROI, margin, payback, budget capacity, or causal lift from traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, performance metrics, or AI usage. Continue existing reconciliation only.

Keep private and parked dispositions unchanged. Continue only existing consolidated legal, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. Do not authorize public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credential or configuration changes, dependency additions, deployment, or external outreach.
